name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Villa Rica GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding chain-link gate across the gravel truck drive at the NE corner off Fleet Dr; seen open in 2024-02 Street View with tractors/trailers inside the fenced yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth beside the entrance lane in any Street View heading; the only structure inside is a maintenance/shop building set deep in the yard, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack, so check-in is via kiosk/call-box/app rather than a staffed booth.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large gravel tractor-staging area immediately inside the NE gate, before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gravel yard from the gate to the dock faces holds well more than 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gravel gate apron with unused width; room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on the south face and the east face of the building.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot on the west side, multiple marked rows full of parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ estimated: long door bank on the south face plus a second bank on the east face, many with trailers backed in.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large DC building plus a small ancillary maintenance/shop building inside the yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town small-industrial setting in Villa Rica surrounded by woods; classed Rural per the tie-break rule.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~36.9 acres from the fenced perimeter polygon (shoelace).
